prompt_section: ## 2. CHARACTER A — Frontend Developer — exact final prompt
prompt_suffix: IDENTITY — the SAME approved person shown in reference #1 (Frontend Developer master); preserve exactly, do NOT redesign: same face and facial structure, short tousled near-black hair (#2B2B3A) with side-swept fringe, light-medium skin (#F2C9A0), no facial hair, charcoal-navy zip hoodie over a plain tee, slim dark jeans, sneakers, over-ear headphones resting around the neck, readable blue accent (#5B8CFF), slim medium build, creative-focused-energetic. He must remain the SAME recognizable character — only the POSE changes. STATE = COFFEE: standing near the Frontend zone on a relaxed short break, holding a clearly visible coffee mug in one hand, calm and casual, slight easy posture. CAMERA: true 3/4 top-down ISOMETRIC, body turned about 30-45 degrees, slight top-down, feet aligned to the isometric floor direction — not front-facing, not profile, not a flat sticker. STYLE: the SAME fine pixel density, thin selective outlines, 3-tone shading and soft ambient occlusion as the IT/Dev floor (reference #2). LIGHTING: warm key light from the upper-left, softer darker shading lower-right, a subtle cyan monitor rim light, gentle ambient occlusion. Standalone single character, fully TRANSPARENT background — NO room, floor, desk, chair, shadow plate, scenery, UI, text, logo or watermark; full body with nothing cropped. REFERENCE PRIORITY: #1 approved character master controls IDENTITY and must be preserved exactly; #2 IT/Dev floor controls perspective, pixel density and lighting; #3 original office image controls the general game-art direction.
